newsitem.title: CANADA: Penn West sets C$47 mln bought-deal issue.
newsitem.headline: Penn West sets C$47 mln bought-deal issue.

text.p: Penn West Petroleum Ltd said it had agreed with a group of underwriters to sell on a bought-deal basis a total of four million shares at C$11.75 each for gross proceeds of C$47 million.

Of the total, C$25 million would be used to finance an increase in the projected 1996 capital spending budget to C$95 million, it said. The rest would be used to pay down the company's bank facility and to fund acquisition, exploration and development activities for 1997.
The underwriting group is being led by FirstEnergy Capital Corp and Griffiths McBurney & Partners and the issue will be by way of a short form prospectus, it said.
